sloka: सो अग्रजेन अनुशिष्ट अर्थो यथावत् पुरुषर्षभः ।प्रविवेश पुरीम् वीरो लक्ष्मणः पर वीर हा ॥४-३१-९॥
transliteration: so agrajena anuśiṣṭa artho yathāvat puruṣarṣabhaḥ ।praviveśa purīm vīro lakṣmaṇaḥ para vīra hā ॥4-31-9॥

translations.english: Having been duly briefed by his elder brother, the heroic Lakshmana, destroyer of enemies, a bull among men entered the city.
